facts: About 2.1 million people in the city itself (2023), 48 m above sea level
On the Seine, in the centre of the Île-de-France region
worth_knowing: First mentioned by Julius Caesar in the mid-1st century BC as Lutetia of the Parisii. It is nicknamed the City of Light mainly for its role in the Age of Enlightenment.
